description: Schema families (spec/sdk-schema.json `families`) whose daemon Command variants and request params cmux-ipc build.rs generates (p05-ipc design 3.3, queue Q15). A family moves here when its hand-written variants in cmux-tui-core server.rs are deleted; check-sdk-schema.py and check-spec-inventory.py read this list for the commands those variants served. `refused_fields` names, per command, a pre-rename field the daemon still reads only to refuse it with invalid-argument, with its reason: not in the schema, so the SDKs never send it.
